feed.title: Engram
feed.subtitle: Updates to Engram, a FalkorDB context graph for coding agents.

entry.title: Native Windows
entry.summary: Engram now runs natively on Windows x64 (no WSL, no Docker) on my own Windows build of FalkorDB 4.18.3. CI checks that the maps, rankings and yt-dlp scores are identical on Linux, macOS and Windows; maps are slower on Windows today.

entry.title: Engram 0.1.0
entry.summary: First release, built for Graph Hacks (WeMakeDevs × FalkorDB). On 144 Claude Code runs over 12 pallets/click bugs: −25% input tokens, −29% tool calls, 35/36 fixed vs 36/36 baseline. Raw data in bench/results.
